# Integrations

SDKs and system frameworks imported by the code, grouped by where they are used. Per IOS-INT-001 they belong in Data (or a shared client); imports from Presentation or Domain are listed in [overrides](overrides.md) as known debt.

| SDK or framework | Areas | Files |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Charts | DashboardView.swift, UsageView.swift | `App/DashboardView.swift`, `App/UsageView.swift` |

Add a row per feature when the integration has product rules (consent, entitlements, endpoints). Never include credentials or real hosts.
